name: 趙莊敏
objective:
本課程旨在協助學生建立經濟學的基礎思維架構，理解個體經濟學的核心概念與分析方法，並能將所學應用於現實生活與時事議題的解讀。本課程從供需、市場均衡、彈性、政府政策到市場效率等主題逐步推進，培養學生運用經濟模型分析問題與提出觀察的能力。

為提升學生的思辨與應用能力，本課程前兩節以理論講授為主，第三節安排小組報告與回饋討論。同學將透過 Zuvio 上傳自己在同儕報告中辨識到的經濟學概念，使當週所學能立即連結至時事與生活情境。此流程讓學生在同一堂課中完成「學習 → 反思 → 實作」，有助於強化概念理解並達成課程目標。

This course aims to help students build a foundational economic mindset, understand key microeconomic concepts and analytical methods, and apply these tools to interpret real-life situations and current events. The course progresses through major topics such as supply and demand, market equilibrium, elasticity, government policies, and market efficiency, equipping students with the ability to analyze issues using economic models and develop informed observations.

To enhance students’ critical thinking and applied learning abilities, the first two class periods each week focus on theoretical instruction, while the third period is dedicated to group presentations and feedback discussions. Students will use the Zuvio platform to submit the economic concepts they identified from their peers’ presentations, allowing them to immediately connect weekly course content with real-world contexts. This structure enables students to complete a full cycle of “learning → reflection → application” within a single session, strengthening conceptual understanding and supporting the achievement of course objectives.
schedule:
Week 1 — Introduction
課程架構、評量方式、分組規則說明

Week 2 — Principles of Economics
十大原理與經濟思維的基礎

Week 3 — Thinking Like an Economist；Group Report #1
經濟模型、假設、科學方法；小組報告與回饋

Week 4 — Production Possibility Frontier；Group Report #2
生產可能曲線、資源配置、機會成本；小組報告與回饋

Week 5 — Principles of Comparative Advantage；Group Report #3
比較優勢、機會成本與專業化；小組報告與回饋

Week 6 — Gains from Trade；Group Report #4
交易利益、專業化與國際貿易概念；小組報告與回饋

Week 7 — In-Class Practice
課堂練習、觀念整合

Week 8 — Discussions on the In-Class Practice Questions
討論課堂練習題、解題與觀念釐清

Week 9 — Midterm Exam
期中考

Week 10 — Demand and Supply；Group Report #5
需求與供給的決定因素；小組報告與回饋

Week 11 — Supply, Demand, and Government Policies；Group Report #6
價格上限、價格下限、政府干預的市場效果；小組報告與回饋

Week 12 — Supply, Demand, and Elasticity；Group Report #7
供需彈性、計算與應用；小組報告與回饋

Week 13 — Consumer Surplus and Producer Surplus；Group Report #8
消費者剩餘與生產者剩餘；小組報告與回饋

Week 14 — Market Efficiency and Market Failure；Group Report #9
市場效率、無謂損失、外部性與市場失靈；小組報告與回饋

Week 15 — Taxation；Group Report #10
稅收的效果、稅負歸屬與無謂損失；小組報告與回饋

Week 16 — In-Class Practice
觀念統整、題目演練

Week 17 — Discussions on the In-Class Practice Questions
練習題討論、觀念釐清、期末準備

Week 18 — Final Exam
期末考
scorePolicy:
平時 20%(讀書報告及課堂練習)
期中考試 35%
經濟會考 10%
期末考試 35%
